subject: Implementation Accelerator: Bluebridge x Redwood — technical ramp request
messages:
From: Oliver Grant <ogrant@bluebridge.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-11T15:03:00Z
Subject: Implementation Accelerator: Bluebridge x Redwood — technical ramp request

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the intro at the alliance summit last week — Bluebridge is excited to move forward. We’re evaluating Redwood for a set of client pilots (finance + retail) and would like to accelerate a technical ramp so our consultants can build two companion integrations in Q1.

Can you share your recommended partner onboarding/accelerator play (what a 2-week technical ramp looks like), the prerequisites we should gather, and any SOW or pricing template you typically use for partner enablement? Also useful: a short checklist of infra access we’ll need for sandbox testing.

Stakeholders on our side: me (technical lead), Priya Nair (PM) and Carlos Mendes (security).

Happy to take a 30-minute discovery next week — we’re flexible Thu/Fri PST.

Thanks,
Oliver Grant
Solutions Director
Bluebridge Consulting
ogrant@bluebridge.io

---
Note: attaching our internal intake form in follow-up if helpful.
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Oliver Grant <ogrant@bluebridge.io>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-12-11T17:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Implementation Accelerator: Bluebridge x Redwood — technical ramp request

Hi Oliver — great to hear and glad we connected. Short answer: we have a compact "Implementation Accelerator" for consulting partners that aligns well with the timeline you described. I’ve outlined a recommended plan below and attached a short onboarding outline + a mutual action plan workbook so we can track responsibilities.

Proposed 2-week Technical Ramp (high level)
- Week 0 (prep, asynchronous): account & sandbox provisioning, security questionnaire + whitelist steps, sample data guidelines.
- Week 1 (deep-dive): architecture walkthrough, model selection & cost profile, hands-on integration lab (tokenization, streaming, error handling, KV cache patterns).
- Week 2 (delivery & handoff): joint run of two feature POCs, performance tuning, rollback/fallback playbook, training session for consultant teams.

Deliverables we’ll provide
- Onboarding outline PDF (attached)
- Mutual action plan (Excel) with dates and owners (attached)
- Sample prompt library + eval harness for regressions
- Short SOW template for partner enablement (we can tailor)

Prerequisites from Bluebridge
- Names and emails for pilot consultants + one security contact
- Minimal sandbox data extract (anonymized) or synthetic templates
- IP/tenant requirements (VPC, data residency) if you need Private deployment options

Proposed discovery slots: Thu 2028-12-14 10:00–10:30 PST or Fri 2028-12-15 09:00–09:30 PST — please confirm what works for your team.

Attachments: bluebridge-onboarding-outline.pdf (2 pages), mutual-action-plan.xlsx (template)

I’ll loop in Sean (partner ops) to coordinate SOW and Aditya (solutions engineering) to scope the labs.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0172
